## Plan

- `scripts/live/cleanup-bl38-residue.mjs` — the guarded driver:
  - `--dry-run` (default; also bare): read-only; resolves the four item families to concrete row
    sets, prints the itemized deletion list with per-row evidence (table, id, salient fields),
    emits a scope verdict (`in-scope` / `out-of-scope`) + JSON artifact.
  - `--apply`: requires `BL38_OPERATOR_GO=confirmed` (the recorded operator go — fail-closed arm,
    mirroring `GOLDEN_BUDGET_RULING=approved`); per item: verbatim row dumps →
    `docs/build/logs/bl38-capture/` (gitignored), redacted dumps →
    `docs/build/reports/<date>_bl38-cleanup/` (token/secret/session/content fields redacted —
    committed evidence carries ids/kinds/counts/timestamps only), then the bounded deletes in a
    single transaction, then post-state verification reads.
  - Per-item guards (fail-closed — anything unexpected → item flagged `blocked`, never deleted):
    draft resolved ONLY on `my-first-project` @ `01M2V3PM11XSF05VJ9G01PM5ZB` and only when no
    out-of-contract referencing rows exist (correspondence/claims/findings/obligations/
    working_copies/descendant base_draft_id/accepted_draft_id); deployments row exact-id +
    `0.4.0+test` signature + full-sha twin present; review account only while its
    `deletion_requested_at` marker is set past grace (the scheduled pipeline — "keep the
    scheduled deletion" per the inventory); LAD projects only title-matched inside the review
    account's own workspace.
- Delete mechanics replicate the deployed canonical orders verbatim: account leg =
  `handleAccountHardDelete`'s 19-statement leaf-first sequence (usage_records anonymized in
  place — the tax-retention arm; workspaces/billing/ledger rows retained per contract);
  project leg (orphan case only) = `handleProjectPurge`'s order.
- `scripts/live/cleanup-bl38-residue.test.mjs` — source pins: dry-run default, the
  `BL38_OPERATOR_GO` fail-closed arm, the verbatim item ids, the guard predicates, the
  capture-before-delete ordering, RLS-bypass requirement note.
- `docs/build/reports/2026-10-15_bl38-cleanup/` — `dry-run.json` + `apply.json` + redacted
  pre-state dumps + post-state verification reads.
- `docs/build/BACKLOG.csv` BL-38 `open`→`closed` + `BACKLOG.md` move to the closed list.
